rows.textLatex: What reverse recovery phenomenon in a power diode?
Classify power diodes according to their reverse recovery time. What are SRD and HRD? Which one is preferred in real life and why?
Show how average power loss in a power diode is calculated from its equivalent circuit.
What is schottky diode? What are the advantages and disadvantages of it?
Why power BJT is operated in the quasi-saturation region?
Explain with the help of circuit diagram how quasi-saturation is implemented?
Sketch the structure of a power MOSFET and explain its working principle. Why power MOSFET cannot block any reverse voltage?
Explain with the help of circuit diagram the working principle of non-isolated Boost DC-DC converter.
Why PWM technique is preferred over FM technique for controlling the duty cycle?

A step-down DC-DC converter is to fed a purely resistive load of 5 Ω. If the input of the converter is 120 V and load current is 10 A, find out the duty cycle needed. If the ON time of the converter is 40 μs, determine the switching frequency.
Explain with the help of a circuit diagram the working principle of a full-bridge inverter for distortion-less output voltage in case of an inductive load.
With the help of a circuit diagram explain the working principle of a push-pull inverter. Explain how average voltage is controlled. What are the advantage and disadvantage of this inverter?

rows.textLatex: Describe the principle of operation of a single phase uncontrolled full wave bridge rectifier with R load and show waveforms of the following: i) Output voltage ii) Load current iii) Diode current iv) Input Line current, and (v) diode voltage. If the single-phase half-wave uncontrolled rectifier is connected with a 230 V,50 Hz A.C supply and the R-L load has the value of R = 100 Ω and L = 0.1H, determine (i) average load current (ii) r.m.s load current, and (iii) the power absorbed by the resistor. Assume the load current conducting up to 40° beyond voltage zero crossing to negative.
